summary: 14 September 2026. First non-demo publishing day: seven ReliefWeb items from WHO, IOM, FAO, WFP and UNHCR were read on the source pages and written as attributed briefs. They describe southern health access, Ghat flood needs, eastern cereal stress, border-route shifts, May market prices, Sudanese arrival estimates, and a May protest near UNHCR in Tripoli. No official CBL or NOC table was attached, so currency and infrastructure rows are not updated from these notes.
